posts.zh:
dsh-easyvision 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。让纯文本模型拥有视觉：describe_image 工具调用 dsh 模型列表中的视觉模型描述图片，走 harness 自身的 LLM 运行时。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-72e809c3adb2f965190b.html
posts.en:
dsh-easyvision is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Give text-only models vision: a describe_image tool that delegates images to a vision model from your dsh model list over the harness's own LLM runtime.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-72e809c3adb2f965190b.html
